title.zh: 卷九十六 志第四十九 河渠六
title.raw: 卷九十六 志第四十九 河渠六 Volume 96 Treatises 49: Rivers and Canals 6

sentences.zh: 東南諸水上

translations.literal: On the waters of the southeast — upper section.
translations.idiomatic: Southeastern Rivers and Canals

sentences.zh: 開寶間，議征江南。

translations.literal: During the Kaibao reign period, the court debated campaigning against Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaibao era, officials discussed an expedition against the Jiangnan region.

sentences.zh: 詔用京西轉運使李符之策，發和州丁夫及鄉兵凡數萬人，鑿橫江渠于曆陽，令符督其役。

translations.literal: An edict adopted the plan of Li Fu, transport commissioner of Jingxi, mobilizing corvée laborers and local militia from He Province totaling tens of thousands of men to cut the Hengjiang Canal at Liyang, with Fu supervising the work.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved the proposal of Li Fu, Commissioner for Transport in the Jingxi circuit, and drafted tens of thousands of corvée workers and militiamen from Hezhou to excavate the Hengjiang Canal at Liyang, placing Fu in charge of the project.

sentences.zh: 渠成，以通漕運，而軍用無闕。

translations.literal: When the canal was completed, grain transport was opened, and military supplies were not wanting.
translations.idiomatic: Once the channel was finished, it served the grain transport network, and the army's needs were fully met.

sentences.zh: 八年，知瓊州李易上言：「州南五里有度靈塘，開修渠堰，溉水田三百余頃，居民賴之。」

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Li Yi, prefect of Qiongzhou, memorialized: 'Five li south of the prefectural seat is Duling Pond; opening and repairing its sluices and weirs irrigates more than three hundred qing of paddy fields, on which the inhabitants rely.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Li Yi, magistrate of Qiongzhou, reported: 'Five li south of the city lies Duling Pond; by restoring its canals and embankments, over three hundred qing of rice land can be irrigated, and the local population depends on it.'

sentences.zh: 初，楚州北山陽灣尤迅急，多有沈溺之患。

translations.literal: Earlier, at Shanyang Bay north of Chuzhou the current was especially swift, and many were drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, the Shanyang Bay north of Chuzhou ran exceptionally fast, and many vessels and travelers were lost to drowning.

sentences.zh: 雍熙中，轉運使劉蟠議開沙河，以避淮水之險，未克而受代。

translations.literal: During the Yongxi reign, Transport Commissioner Liu Pan proposed opening the Sha River to avoid the dangers of the Huai, but before completion he was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongxi period, Transport Commissioner Liu Pan urged cutting the Sha River to skirt the perils of the Huai, yet he left office before the work could be finished.

sentences.zh: 喬維岳繼之，開河自楚州至淮陰，凡六十里，舟行便之。

translations.literal: Qiao Weiyue succeeded him, opening a channel from Chuzhou to Huaiyin, altogether sixty li, and boat travel was made convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Weiyue took his post and opened a waterway from Chuzhou to Huaiyin, sixty li in all, so that shipping passed with far less trouble.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年，知升州丁謂言：「城北有後湖，往時歲旱水竭，給為民田，凡七十六頃，出租錢數百萬，蔭溉之利遂廢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianxi, Ding Wei, prefect of Shengzhou, said: 'North of the city is Rear Lake; in past years, when drought dried the water, it was given out as farmland, seventy-six qing in all, yielding rent of several million cash, and the benefit of shade and irrigation was thereby lost.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianxi 1, Ding Wei, administrator of Shengzhou (Nanjing), stated: 'North of the city stands Rear Lake; in earlier drought years its waters were drained and the bed was parceled to farmers—seventy-six qing in all, yielding millions in rent—while the lake's storage and irrigation were abandoned.'

sentences.zh: 令欲改田除租，跡舊制，復治岸畔，疏為塘陂以畜水，使負郭無旱歲，廣植浦芡，養魚鱉，縱貧民漁采。

translations.literal: Now I wish to return the fields and remove the rent, follow the old regulations, restore the banks, dredge ponds and reservoirs to store water, so that lands near the city have no drought years, widely plant lotus and water chestnuts, raise fish and turtles, and allow the poor to fish and gather.
translations.idiomatic: I propose to revert those fields, cancel the levy, restore the old regime, rebuild the shore, and shape ponds and dykes to hold water so suburbs escape famine years; plant aquatic crops, stock fish and soft-shelled turtles, and let the poor harvest by fishing and foraging.'

sentences.zh: 」又明州請免濠池及慈溪、鄞縣陂湖年課，許民射利。

translations.literal: ' Mingzhou also requested exemption from annual levies on the moat-ponds and the lakes and embankments of Cixi and Yin counties, permitting the people to take profit.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhou likewise asked that annual dues on its moat-ponds and the lakes and dykes of Cixi and Yin be lifted so commoners might profit from them.'

sentences.zh: 詔並從之。

translations.literal: Edicts approved all alike.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved every request.

sentences.zh: 二年，江、淮發運使賈宗言：「諸路歲漕，自真、揚入淮、汴，曆堰者五，糧載煩於剝卸，民力罷於牽挽，官私船艦，由此速壞。

translations.literal: In the second year, Jia Zong, transport commissioner for the Jiang-Huai grain route, said: 'Each year the circuits send tribute grain from Zhen and Yang into the Huai and Bian, passing five barrages; grain loads are troubled by transshipment, and the people's strength is exhausted in hauling; government and private vessels alike are quickly ruined thereby.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Jia Zong, commissioner of the Jiang-Huai transport route, wrote: 'Annual tribute grain from the circuits enters the Huai and Bian from Zhenzhou and Yangzhou by way of five locks; cargo must be shifted at each lift, haulers are worn out, and both public and private craft are wrecked in the process.'

sentences.zh: 今議開揚州古河，繚城南接運渠，毀龍舟、新興、茱萸三堰，鑿近堰漕路，以均水勢。

translations.literal: Now it is proposed to open Yangzhou's ancient river, winding south of the city to join the transport channel, destroy the three barrages of Longzhou, Xinxing, and Zhuyu, and cut a transport road near the barrages to equalize the water level.
translations.idiomatic: We propose reopening Yangzhou's old river so it skirts the south wall and meets the canal, removing the Longzhou, Xinxing, and Zhuyu barrages, and cutting a channel beside the locks to level the current.'

sentences.zh: 歲省官費十數萬，功利甚厚。

translations.literal: Each year several hundred thousand in official expenses would be saved, and the benefit would be very great.
translations.idiomatic: Official costs would fall by hundreds of thousands each year, with substantial overall gain.'

sentences.zh: 」詔屯田郎中梁楚、閣門祗候李居中按視，以為當然。

translations.literal: ' Edicts ordered Langzhong Liang Chu of the Tuntian Bureau and Palace Attendant Li Juzhong to inspect on site, and they judged it fitting.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered Liang Chu of the Agriculture Bureau and Li Juzhong, palace attendant, to survey the works; both reported favorably.'

sentences.zh: 明年，役既成，而水注新河，與三堰平，漕船無阻，公私大便。

translations.literal: The next year the labor was finished; water poured into the new river and stood level with the three barrages; transport vessels met no obstruction, and public and private interests were greatly eased.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the project was done; the new stream matched the three locks, transport boats passed unimpeded, and both state and merchants benefited greatly.

sentences.zh: 四年，淮南勸農使王貫之導海州石闥堰水入漣水軍，溉民田；

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Wang Guanzhi, agricultural commissioner of Huainan, led water from the Shitai barrage of Haizhou into Lianshui Army to irrigate civilian fields;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Wang Guanzhi, Huainan agricultural commissioner, diverted Haizhou's Shitai barrage waters into Lianshui garrison to irrigate farmland;

sentences.zh: 知定遠縣江澤、知江陰軍崔立率民修廢塘，浚古港，以灌高仰之地。

translations.literal: Jiang Ze, magistrate of Dingyuan, and Cui Li, military commissioner of Jiangyin, led the people to repair abandoned ponds, dredge old harbors, and irrigate high-lying land.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Ze of Dingyuan and Cui Li of Jiangyin organized the people to restore derelict reservoirs, clear ancient ports, and water fields on higher ground.

sentences.zh: 並賜詔獎焉。

translations.literal: Imperial edicts of commendation were bestowed on all.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial commendations were issued to them all.

sentences.zh: 神宗熙甯元年十月，詔：「杭之長安、秀之杉青、常之望亭三堰，監護使臣並以'管幹河塘'系銜，常同所屬令佐，巡視修固，以時啟閉。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Xining under Emperor Shenzong, an edict said: 'For the three barrages—Chang'an of Hang, Shanqing of Xiu, and Wangting of Chang—the supervising commissioners shall all bear the title "Controller of River Embankments," and together with their subordinate magistrates shall regularly inspect, repair, and open or close them in season.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Xining 1, Shenzong decreed: 'At Hangzhou's Chang'an, Xiuzhou's Shanqing, and Changzhou's Wangting barrages, supervising officials shall carry the title "River and Dyke Controller" and, with local magistrates, inspect, maintain, and operate the gates on schedule.'

sentences.zh: 」從堤舉兩浙開修河渠胡淮之請也。

translations.literal: ' This followed the request of Hu Huai, who had proposed opening and repairing rivers and canals in the two Zhe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: The order followed a memorial from Hu Huai on dredging waterways in the Two-Zhe region.

sentences.zh: 二年三月甲申，先是，淩民瞻建議廢呂城堰，又即望亭堰置閘而不用。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of the third month of the second year—earlier, Ling Minzhan had proposed abolishing the Lücheng barrage and placing a gate at Wangting barrage without using it.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month's jiashen day in year two—earlier Ling Minzhan had urged abolishing Lücheng barrage and installing a sluice at Wangting that was never properly used.

sentences.zh: 及因浚河，隳敗古涇函、石閘、石鹈達，河流益阻，百姓勞弊，至是，民瞻等貶降有差。

translations.literal: When the river was dredged, the ancient Jing culvert, stone gate, and Shijie sluice were destroyed, the current grew more obstructed, and the people were worn and afflicted; at this time Minzhan and others were demoted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Dredging then wrecked the old Jing conduit, stone lock, and Shijie gate; the stream blocked further, the populace suffered, and Minzhan and his colleagues were demoted by differing ranks.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，杭州于潛縣令郟亶言：「蘇州環湖地卑多水，沿海地高多旱，故古人治水之跡，縱則有浦，橫則有塘，又有門堰、涇瀝而棋布之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, Zheng Dan, magistrate of Yuqian in Hangzhou, said: 'Suzhou's lands within the lake ring are low and waterlogged; coastal lands are high and drought-prone; hence traces of ancient waterworks run vertically as channels and horizontally as embankments, with sluice-gates, Jing conduits, and drainage ditches arrayed like a chessboard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year six, Zheng Dan, magistrate of Yuqian in Hangzhou, wrote: 'Around Suzhou, lake-side ground lies low and floods easily, while the coast sits high and dries often; antiquity's pattern placed longitudinal estuaries and cross dykes, with gates, Jing channels, and drains set like a grid.'

sentences.zh: 今總二百六十餘所。

translations.literal: Today they total more than two hundred sixty-odd sites.
translations.idiomatic: More than two hundred sixty such works survive today.'

sentences.zh: 欲略循古人之法，七里為一縱浦，十里為一橫塘，又因出土，以為堤岸，度用夫二十萬。

translations.literal: I wish broadly to follow the ancients' method: one longitudinal channel every seven li, one cross embankment every ten li, and use the excavated earth to form dykes, estimating two hundred thousand laborers.
translations.idiomatic: I propose broadly reviving the old design—one longitudinal creek every seven li, one transverse embankment every ten li, earth from digging to raise levees, at a cost of two hundred thousand workers.'

sentences.zh: 水治高田，旱治下澤，不過三年，蘇之田畢治矣。

translations.literal: In flood years treat the high fields; in drought years treat the low marshes; within three years Suzhou's fields could all be regulated.
translations.idiomatic: Wet years would drain the upland farms; dry years would water the low marsh; within three years Suzhou's fields could be fully brought under control.'

sentences.zh: 」十一月，命亶興修水利。

translations.literal: ' In the eleventh month he was ordered to undertake waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Dan was ordered to launch hydraulic works.

sentences.zh: 然措置乖方，民多愁怨，僅及一年，遂罷兩浙工役。

translations.literal: Yet the arrangements were perverse, and the people were much resentful; after barely a year the corvée in the two Zhe circuits was halted.
translations.idiomatic: His measures proved ill-conceived, popular resentment mounted, and after scarcely a year corvée in the Two Zhe was stopped.

sentences.zh: 又數月，中書檢正沈括復言：「浙西涇浜淺涸，當浚；

translations.literal: Several months later, Shen Kuo, reviser of the Secretariat, again said: 'In western Zhe the Jing creeks and harbors are shallow and dry and should be dredged;
translations.idiomatic: Months later Secretariat reviser Shen Kuo reported: 'Western Zhe's Jing streams and creeks have silted shallow and need dredging;

sentences.zh: 浙東堤防川瀆堙沒，當修。

translations.literal: in eastern Zhe the dykes and main rivers are buried and should be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: eastern Zhe's levees and trunk channels are choked and need repair.'

sentences.zh: 請下司農貸緡募役。

translations.literal: Request that the Ministry of Revenue lend cash to hire labor.
translations.idiomatic: He asked the Ministry of Revenue to lend funds to hire workers.'

sentences.zh: 」從之，仍命括相度兩浙水利。

translations.literal: ' Approval was given, and Kuo was still ordered to survey waterworks in both Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed and also commissioned Kuo to survey hydraulics in both circuits.

sentences.zh: 九年正月壬午，劉瑾言：「揚州江都縣古鹽河、高郵縣陳公塘等湖、天長縣白馬塘沛塘、楚州寶應縣泥港射馬港、山陽縣渡塘溝龍興浦、淮陰縣青州澗、宿州虹縣萬安湖小河、壽州安豐縣芍陂等，可興置，欲令逐路轉運司選官覆按。

translations.literal: On the day rewu of the first month of the ninth year, Liu Jin said: 'The ancient salt river of Jiangdu in Yangzhou, the Chen Gong Pond and other lakes of Gaoyou, the Baima and Pei ponds of Tianchang, the Nigang and Shema harbors of Baoying in Chuzhou, the Dutang, Gou, Longxing, and Pu of Shanyang, the Qingzhou Ravine of Huaiyin, the small river of Wan'an Lake in Hong county of Suzhou, the Shao Pond of Anfeng in Shouzhou, and the like may all be revived; I ask that each circuit transport office choose officials to re-inspect.
translations.idiomatic: On the first month's rewu day in year nine, Liu Jin listed restorable works—from Yangzhou Jiangdu's old salt river and Gaoyou's Chen Gong pond to Tianchang's Baima and Pei ponds, Chuzhou Baoying's mud and Shema ports, Shanyang's Dutang and Longxing creeks, Huaiyin's Qingzhou gully, Suzhou Hong's Wan'an Lake branch, and Shouzhou Anfeng's Shao reservoir—and urged each transport commissioner to assign officers to verify them.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ' Approval was given.
translations.idiomatic: The throne assented.

sentences.zh: 元豐五年九月，淮南監司言：「舒州近城有大澤，出灊山，注北門外。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Yuanfeng, Huainan supervisory officials reported: 'Near Shuzhou city is a great marsh issuing from Qian Mountain and pouring out the north gate.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 5, ninth month, Huainan supervisors reported: 'Beside Shuzhou lies a great marsh fed from Qian Mountain that debouches at the north gate.'

sentences.zh: 比者，暴水漂居民，知州楊希元築捍水堤千一百五十丈，置泄水斗門二，遂免淫潦入城之患。

translations.literal: Recently sudden floods swept away inhabitants; Prefect Yang Xiyuan built flood-control dykes of one thousand one hundred fifty zhang and set two drainage sluice-gates, and the affliction of inundation entering the city was thereby removed.
translations.idiomatic: Recent flash floods had overrun dwellings; Prefect Yang Xiyuan built 1,150 zhang of flood wall and two drainage gates, ending inundation of the city.'

sentences.zh: 」並璽書獎諭。

translations.literal: ' Sealed edicts of reward and instruction were sent together.
translations.idiomatic: Sealed edicts of praise followed.

sentences.zh: 六年正月戊辰，開龜山運河，二月乙未告成，長五十七里，闊十五丈，深一丈五尺。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen of the first month of the sixth year the Tortoise Mountain transport canal was opened; on the day yiwei of the second month completion was announced—length fifty-seven li, width fifteen zhang, depth one zhang five chi.
translations.idiomatic: On the first month's wuchen in year six work began on the Guishan transport canal; on the second month's yiwei it was declared finished—fifty-seven li long, fifteen zhang wide, one zhang five chi deep.

sentences.zh: 初，發運使許元自淮陰開新河，屬之洪澤，避長淮之險，凡四十九里。

translations.literal: Earlier, Transport Commissioner Xu Yuan had opened a new river from Huaiyin linking to Hongze to avoid the long Huai's dangers, altogether forty-nine li.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Commissioner Xu Yuan had cut a new channel from Huaiyin to Hongze, forty-nine li, to skirt the treacherous main Huai.

sentences.zh: 久而淺澀，熙寧四年，皮公弼請復浚治，起十一月壬寅，盡明年正月丁酉而畢，人便之。

translations.literal: After long years it silted shallow; in the fourth year of Xining, Pi Gongbi requested renewed dredging; work began on the day renyin of the eleventh month and was finished on the day dingyou of the first month of the next year, to the people's convenience.
translations.idiomatic: It later shoaled; in Xining 4 Pi Gongbi sought re-dredging from the eleventh month's renyin through the next first month's dingyou, to general relief.

sentences.zh: 至是，發運使羅拯復欲自洪澤而上，鑿龜山裏河以達於淮，帝深然之。

translations.literal: At this time Transport Commissioner Luo Zheng again wished to cut from above Hongze the inner Guishan river to reach the Huai; the Emperor deeply approved.
translations.idiomatic: Now Commissioner Luo Zheng proposed extending from Hongze upstream an inner Guishan channel to the Huai; the emperor strongly endorsed it.

sentences.zh: 會發運使蔣之奇入對，建言：「上有清汴，下有洪澤，而風浪之險止百里淮，邇歲溺公私之載不可計。

translations.literal: When Transport Commissioner Jiang Zhiqi came to audience he memorialized: 'Above is the clear Bian; below is Hongze; yet the peril of wind and waves extends only a hundred li on the Huai; in recent years public and private cargoes lost to drowning are beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiang Zhiqi presented himself he argued: 'With the clear Bian above and Hongze below, only a hundred li of Huai surf remains deadly; yearly losses of public and private shipping are incalculable.'

sentences.zh: 凡諸道轉輸，涉湖行江，已數千里，而覆敗於此百里間，良為可惜。

translations.literal: All circuits' transport, having crossed lakes and rivers for thousands of li, yet founders in this hundred-li stretch—truly it is a pity.
translations.idiomatic: Convoys that have sailed thousands of li on lakes and rivers still perish in this hundred-li gap—a grievous waste.'

sentences.zh: 宜自龜山蛇浦下屬洪澤，鑿左肋為復河，取淮為源，不置堰閘，可免風濤覆溺之患。

translations.literal: It is fitting from Guishan's Shepu downstream to Hongze to cut the left flank as a return channel, taking the Huai as source, setting no barrage or gate, and thus avoiding the calamity of overturning in wind and waves.
translations.idiomatic: From Guishan's Shepu down to Hongze one should cut a return channel on the left bank, fed by the Huai without locks, to escape wind and wreck.'

sentences.zh: 」帝遣都水監丞陳祐甫經度。

translations.literal: ' The Emperor sent Director of Waterworks Chen Youfu to plan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dispatched Director Chen Youfu to plan the work.

sentences.zh: 祐甫言：「往年田棐任淮南提刑，嘗言開河之利。

translations.literal: Youfu said: 'In former years Tian Fei, when Huainan investigating commissioner, once spoke of the benefit of opening the river.
translations.idiomatic: Youfu noted: 'Years ago investigating commissioner Tian Fei had urged this canal.'

sentences.zh: 其後淮陰至洪澤，竟開新河，獨洪澤以上，未克興役。

translations.literal: Afterward from Huaiyin to Hongze a new river was indeed opened, but above Hongze the work could not be launched.
translations.idiomatic: Later Huaiyin to Hongze was cut, but the reach above Hongze was never attempted.'

sentences.zh: 今既不用閘蓄水，惟隨淮面高下，開深河底，引淮通流，形勢為便。

translations.literal: Now, without using gates to store water, only following the Huai's surface level and deepening the bed to draw the Huai through, the configuration is advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: Without sluices to impound water, following the Huai's surface and deepening the bed to draw the river through is the advantageous course.'

sentences.zh: 但工費浩大。

translations.literal: Only the labor cost is vast.
translations.idiomatic: Only the expense is enormous.'

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「費雖大，利亦博矣。

translations.literal: ' The Emperor said: 'Though the cost is great, the benefit is also broad.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: 'Cost is heavy, but gain is greater.'

sentences.zh: 」祐甫曰：「異時，淮中歲失百七十艘。

translations.literal: ' Youfu said: 'In other years on the Huai a hundred seventy vessels were lost annually.
translations.idiomatic: Youfu added: 'The Huai once lost some one hundred seventy craft a year.'

sentences.zh: 若捐數年所損之費，足濟此役。

translations.literal: If one devoted several years' losses, it would suffice for this project.
translations.idiomatic: A few years of those losses would fund the work.'

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「損費尚小，如人命何。

translations.literal: ' The Emperor said: 'Material loss is still small; what of human lives?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'Property is little; lives are not.'

sentences.zh: 」乃調夫十萬開治，既成，命之奇撰記，刻石龜山，後至建中靖國初，之奇同知樞密院，奏：「淮水浸淫，沖刷堤岸，漸成墊缺，請下發運司及時修築。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon a hundred thousand laborers were mobilized; when finished, Zhiqi was ordered to compose a record and inscribe stone at Guishan; later, at the beginning of the Jianzhong Jingguo era, Zhiqi as vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: 'The Huai's encroaching flood scours the dykes and gradually forms breaches; request that the transport office repair in season.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred thousand workers were called up; on completion Zhiqi wrote the inscription at Guishan; later, early in Jianzhong Jingguo, now vice director of military affairs, he urged seasonal repair as the Huai undercut the banks.

sentences.zh: 」自是，歲以為常。

translations.literal: ' From this it became annual practice.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter repair became yearly routine.

sentences.zh: 是年，將作監主簿李湜言：「鼎、澧等州，宜開溝洫，置斗門，以便民田。

translations.literal: That year, Registrar Li Shen of the Directorate of Works said: 'Ding, Li, and other prefectures should open ditches and set sluice-gates for the convenience of civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: That year Works registrar Li Shen urged ditches and sluice-gates in Dingzhou, Lizhou, and similar prefectures to aid farming.

sentences.zh: 」詔措置以聞。

translations.literal: ' An edict ordered arrangements to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered plans submitted.

sentences.zh: 七年十月，浚真、楚運河。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the seventh year the Zhen and Chu transport canals were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year seven the Zhen and Chu canals were cleared.

sentences.zh: 哲宗元祐四年，知潤州林希奏復呂城堰，置上下閘，以時啟閉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanyou under Emperor Zhezong, Lin Xi, prefect of Runzhou, memorialized restoring the Lücheng barrage and setting upper and lower gates to open and close in season.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou 4, Runzhou prefect Lin Xi sought restoration of Lücheng barrage with upper and lower gates operated on schedule.

sentences.zh: 其後，京口、瓜州、奔牛皆置閘。

translations.literal: Afterward Jingkou, Guazhou, and Benniu all had gates installed.
translations.idiomatic: Later Jingkou, Guazhou, and Benniu likewise received sluices.

sentences.zh: 是歲，知杭州蘇軾浚茆山、鹽橋二河，分受江潮及西湖水，造堰閘，以時啟閉。

translations.literal: That year Su Shi, prefect of Hangzhou, dredged the Mao and Yanzhao rivers, dividing the reception of tidal water and West Lake water, building barrages and gates to open and close in season.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hangzhou prefect Su Shi cleared the Mao and Salt Bridge rivers, splitting Yangtze tide and West Lake inflow, and built locks opened seasonally.

sentences.zh: 初，杭近海，患水泉咸苦，唐刺史李泌始導西湖，作六井，民以足用。

translations.literal: Earlier Hangzhou lay near the sea; the people suffered brackish springs; Tang prefect Li Bi first led West Lake and made six wells, and the people had enough.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou had long faced salty groundwater; Tang prefect Li Bi first tapped West Lake and sank six wells so the city had adequate water.

sentences.zh: 及白居易復浚西湖，引水入運河，復引溉田千頃。

translations.literal: Bai Juyi again dredged West Lake, led water into the transport canal, and again drew irrigation for a thousand qing.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Juyi later re-dredged the lake, fed the canal, and irrigated a thousand qing.

sentences.zh: 湖水多葑，自唐及錢氏後廢而不理。

translations.literal: The lake water was much choked with duckweed; from Tang through the Qian clan it was abandoned and not regulated.
translations.idiomatic: Duckweed choked the lake; from Tang through the Wuyue Qian house it was neglected.

sentences.zh: 至是，葑積二十五萬餘丈，而水無幾。

translations.literal: At this time duckweed accumulated to more than two hundred fifty thousand zhang, and there was little water.
translations.idiomatic: By now weed had piled to over two hundred fifty thousand zhang while water shrank.

sentences.zh: 運河失湖水之利，取給于江潮，潮水淤河，泛溢闤闠，三年一浚，為市井大患，故六井亦幾廢。

translations.literal: The transport canal lost the lake's benefit and relied on the Yangtze tide; tidal silt choked the canal, flooding the markets; dredging every three years was a great urban affliction, and the six wells nearly failed.
translations.idiomatic: The canal lost lake supply and depended on tidal Yangtze water that silted the channel and flooded wards; triennial dredging tormented the city and nearly ruined the six wells.

sentences.zh: 軾既浚二河，復以餘力全六井，民獲其利。

translations.literal: After Shi had dredged the two rivers, he still used spare effort to complete the six wells, and the people received the benefit.
translations.idiomatic: After clearing the two rivers Shi restored the six wells at spare labor, to public benefit.

sentences.zh: 十二月，京東轉運司言：「清河與江、浙、淮南諸路相通，因徐州呂梁、百步兩洪湍淺險惡，多壞舟楫，由是水手、牛驢、扌牽戶、盤剝人等，邀阻百端，商賈不行。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Jingdong transport office said: 'The Qing River connects with Jiang, Zhe, and Huainan routes, but at Xuzhou's Lüliang and Baibu the rapids are shallow, perilous, and evil, ruining many boats; therefore boatmen, oxen, donkeys, haulers, and transshipment agents obstruct in a hundred ways, and merchants do not pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Jingdong transport reported: 'The Qing River links the Jiang-Zhe and Huainan routes, yet at Xuzhou's Lüliang and Baibu rapids are shallow and deadly, wrecking craft; haulers and lighterage gangs extort endlessly and trade stalls.'

sentences.zh: 朝廷已委齊州通判滕希靖、知常州晉陵縣趙竦度地勢穿鑿。

translations.literal: The court had already entrusted Qi prefecture Vice Prefect Teng Xijing and Jinling magistrate Zhao Song to survey terrain and bore through.
translations.idiomatic: The court had assigned Qi vice-prefect Teng Xijing and Jinling magistrate Zhao Song to survey and cut a channel.

sentences.zh: 今若開修月河石堤，上下置閘，以時開閉，通放舟船，實為長利。

translations.literal: If now the moon-river and stone dyke are opened and repaired, with upper and lower gates opened and closed in season to release boats, it is truly a lasting benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Opening a bypass moon-river with stone levees and timed gates would release shipping and yield lasting gain.'

sentences.zh: 乞遣使監督興修。

translations.literal: I beg that an envoy be sent to supervise the work.
translations.idiomatic: We ask an inspector to supervise construction.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ' Approval was given.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 紹聖二年，詔「武進、丹陽、丹徒縣界沿河堤岸及石鹈達、石木溝，並委令佐檢察修護，勸誘食利人戶修葺。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaosheng an edict said: 'Along the dykes from Wujin, Danyang, and Dantu counties and the Shijie sluice and Shimugou, all shall be entrusted to magistrates to inspect and maintain, encouraging profit-taking households to repair.
translations.idiomatic: Shaosheng 2 decreed: 'Dykes along Wujin, Danyang, and Dantu, and the Shijie and Shimugou works, shall be inspected and kept up by magistrates, with incentives for local contractors.'

sentences.zh: 任滿，稽其勤惰而賞罰之。

translations.literal: At term's end their diligence or sloth shall be examined for reward and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: At term's end diligence or neglect would govern rewards and penalties.'

sentences.zh: 」從工部之請也。

translations.literal: ' This followed the Ministry of Works' request.
translations.idiomatic: This followed a memorial from the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，水部員外郎趙竦請浚十八里河，令賈種民相度呂梁、百步洪，添移水磨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year Waterworks Vice Director Zhao Song requested dredging the Eighteen-li River and ordered Jia Zhongmin to survey Lüliang and Baibu and relocate water mills.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year four Zhao Song of Waterworks sought dredging the Eighteen-li River and sent Jia Zhongmin to survey Lüliang and Baibu and move mills.

sentences.zh: 詔發運並轉運司同視利害以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the transport and circuit transport offices jointly to inspect benefit and harm and report.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts ordered grain transport and circuit commissioners to assess costs and benefits jointly.

sentences.zh: 元符元年正月，知潤州王悆建言：「呂城閘常宜單水入澳，灌注閘身以濟舟。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yuanfu, Wang Yi, prefect of Run, memorialized: 'The Lücheng gate should regularly let water alone into the basin to fill the gate body and aid boats.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfu 1, first month: Runzhou prefect Wang Yi urged that Lücheng lock keep a solo head of water in the basin to float the gate timbers for shipping.

sentences.zh: 若舟遝至而力不給，許量差牽駕兵卒，並力為之。

translations.literal: If boats arrive in a crowd and strength is insufficient, allow measured drafting of towing soldiers to assist together.
translations.idiomatic: When convoys piled up and labor fell short, towing troops might be drafted to assist.'

sentences.zh: 監官任滿，水無走泄者賞，水未應而輒開閘者罰，守貳、令佐，常覺察之。

translations.literal: When the supervising officer's term ends, reward if no water escapes; punish if the gate is opened before the water should respond; prefects and magistrates shall constantly oversee.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisors finishing term without leakage would be rewarded; opening early would be punished; prefects and magistrates must watch constantly.'

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: ' Edict: approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，工部言：「淮南開河所開修楚州支家河，導漣水與淮通。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin of the third month the Ministry of Works said: 'The Zhijia River opened in Huainan leads Lianshui to join the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Third month jiayin: Works reported Huainan's newly cut Zhijia River linking Lianshui to the Huai.'

sentences.zh: 」賜名通漣河。

translations.literal: ' It was granted the name Tonglian River.
translations.idiomatic: It was named the Tonglian River.

sentences.zh: 二年閏九月，潤州京口、常州奔牛澳閘畢工。

translations.literal: In the intercalary ninth month of the second year the Jingkou and Benniu basin gates of Run were completed.
translations.idiomatic: Second year intercalary ninth month: Run's Jingkou and Changzhou Benniu basin locks were finished.

sentences.zh: 先是，兩浙轉運判官曾孝蘊獻澳閘利害，因命孝蘊提舉興修，仍相度立啟閉日限之法。

translations.literal: Earlier the Two-Zhe transport vice commissioner Zeng Xiaoyun had presented the benefits and harms of basin gates; therefore Xiaoyun was ordered to direct construction and also to set laws for dates of opening and closing.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Two-Zhe vice commissioner Zeng Xiaoyun had analyzed basin locks; he was placed in charge and charged to fix opening schedules.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，詔：「蘇、湖、秀州，凡開治運河、港浦、溝瀆，修壘堤岸，開置斗門、水堰等，許役開江兵卒。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year an edict said: 'In Su, Hu, and Xiu prefectures, wherever transport canals, harbors, and ditches are opened or dykes built, with sluice-gates and water barrages installed, use of river-opening troops is permitted.'
translations.idiomatic: Third year second month: edict allowed river-opening troops for canal, harbor, ditch, dyke, and sluice work in Suzhou, Huzhou, and Xiuzhou.

sentences.zh: 徽宗崇甯元年十二月，置提舉淮、浙澳閘司官一員，掌杭州至揚州瓜洲澳閘，凡常、潤、杭、秀、揚州新舊等閘，通治之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Chongning under Emperor Huizong, one office of Commissioner for Huai and Zhe Basin Gates was established, managing basin gates from Hangzhou to Guazhou at Yangzhou, all old and new gates of Chang, Run, Hang, Xiu, and Yang being under unified administration.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong Chongning 1, twelfth month: a commissioner for Huai-Zhe basin locks was created, governing locks from Hangzhou to Yangzhou's Guazhou across Chang, Run, Hang, Xiu, and Yang.

sentences.zh: 崇寧二年初，通直郎陳仲方別議浚吳松江，自大通浦入海，計工二百二十二萬七千有奇，為緡錢、糧斛十八萬三千六百，乞置幹當官十員。

translations.literal: Early in the second year of Chongning, Expectant Gentleman Chen Zhongfang separately proposed dredging the Wusong River from Datong Pu to the sea, estimating labor at two million two hundred twenty-seven thousand odd, cash and grain rations at one hundred eighty-three thousand six hundred, and requesting ten project officers.
translations.idiomatic: Early Chongning 2, Chen Zhongfang proposed dredging Wusong from Datong Pu to the sea—2.27 million labor units, 183,600 in cash and grain—and ten overseers.

sentences.zh: 朝廷下兩浙監司詳議，監司以為可行。

translations.literal: The court sent it down to the Two-Zhe supervisory offices for detailed deliberation; the supervisors judged it feasible.
translations.idiomatic: Two-Zhe supervisors reviewed the plan and deemed it viable.

sentences.zh: 時又開青龍江，役夫不勝其勞，而提舉常平徐確謂：「三州開江兵卒千四百人，使臣二人，請就令護察已開之江，遇潮沙淤澱，隨即開淘；

translations.literal: At the same time the Qinglong River was also opened; corvée could not bear the labor, while Ever-Normal Commissioner Xu Que said: 'Three prefectures have one thousand four hundred river-opening troops and two envoys; request that they guard already opened rivers and dredge whenever tide silt fills in;
translations.idiomatic: Qinglong River works ran concurrently; laborers collapsed under the burden while Ever-Normal commissioner Xu Que urged 1,400 river troops in three prefectures to maintain opened channels and clear tidal silt promptly;

sentences.zh: 若他役者，以違制論。

translations.literal: whoever uses them for other tasks shall be judged under the statute for violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: diversion to other tasks would be punished as violation of regulations.'

sentences.zh: 」確與監司往往被賞，人以為濫。

translations.literal: ' Que and the supervisors were often rewarded, and people regarded it as excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Que and supervisors were frequently rewarded, which many deemed excessive.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔淮南開修遇明河，自真州宣化鎮江口至泗州淮河口，五年畢工。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month an edict ordered Huainan to open and repair the Yuming River from Zhenzhou's Xuanhua Town river mouth to Sizhou's Huai mouth, to be completed in five years.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: Huainan was ordered to open the Yuming River from Zhenzhou Xuanhua to Sizhou Huai mouth over five years.

sentences.zh: 明年三月，詔曰：「昨二浙水災，委官調夫開江，而總領無法，役人暴露，飲食失所，疾病死亡者眾。

translations.literal: In the third month of the next year an edict said: 'Last year the two Zhe suffered flood; officials were sent to mobilize labor to open rivers, yet overall control was lacking, laborers were exposed, food and lodging were lost, and many died of disease;
translations.idiomatic: Next year third month: edict recalled last year's Two-Zhe flood works—corvée lacked coordination, workers were exposed without food or shelter, disease killed many;

sentences.zh: 水仍為害，未嘗究實按罪，反蒙推賞，何以厭塞百姓怨咨。

translations.literal: water still harmed, and never were facts investigated and guilt assigned, yet rewards were instead received—how can the people's complaints be stilled?
translations.idiomatic: floods persisted, no one was punished though promoters were rewarded—how could popular resentment be appeased?'

sentences.zh: 」乃下本路提刑司體量。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon the circuit judicial commission of this route was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit judicial commissioner was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 提刑司言：「開浚吳松、青龍江，役夫五萬，死者千一百六十二人，費錢米十六萬九千三百四十一貫石，積水至今未退。

translations.literal: The judicial commission said: 'Opening Wusong and Qinglong employed fifty thousand laborers; the dead were one thousand one hundred sixty-two; cash and rice expended were one hundred sixty-nine thousand three hundred forty-one guan and shi; pooled water has not yet receded.
translations.idiomatic: Judicial report: Wusong and Qinglong used fifty thousand workers, 1,162 dead, 169,341 guan and shi spent, and standing water remained.'

sentences.zh: 」於是元相度官轉運副使劉何等皆坐貶降。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon Liu He and other former survey officials were all demoted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Former planners including Vice Transport Commissioner Liu He were demoted accordingly.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，以倉部員外郎沈延嗣提舉開修青草、洞庭直河。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, Xu Yansi, outer director of the Granary Bureau, was appointed to direct opening of the Green Grass and Dongting Straight rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year first month: Granary outer director Xu Yansi was assigned to open the Green Grass and Dongting direct channels.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年五月，中書舍人許光凝奏：「臣向在姑蘇，遍詢民吏，皆謂欲去水患，莫若開江浚浦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Daguan, Secretariat Drafter Xu Guangning memorialized: 'When I was at Gusu I questioned officials and people everywhere; all said that to remove flood harm one must open rivers and dredge creeks.
translations.idiomatic: Daguan 1, fifth month: drafter Xu Guangning, formerly at Suzhou, reported universal opinion that flood relief requires opening rivers and dredging estuaries.

sentences.zh: 蓋太湖在諸郡間，必導之海然後水有所歸。

translations.literal: For Lake Tai lies among the prefectures and must be led to the sea before water has a destination.
translations.idiomatic: Taihu sits among the prefectures and must discharge to the sea before waters find their course.

sentences.zh: 自太湖距海，有三江，有諸浦，能疏滌江、浦，除水患猶反掌耳。

translations.literal: From Taihu to the sea are three rivers and many creeks; if the rivers and creeks can be dredged, removing flood harm is like turning the hand.
translations.idiomatic: Three great rivers and many creeks run from the lake to the sea; clearing them would drain floods with ease.

sentences.zh: 今境內積水，視去歲損二尺，視前歲損四尺，良由初開吳松江，繼浚八浦之力也。

translations.literal: Now standing water within the territory is two chi less than last year and four chi less than the year before—truly owing to the strength of first opening Wusong and then dredging the eight creeks.
translations.idiomatic: Standing water now stands two chi below last year and four below the year before—thanks to opening Wusong and dredging eight creeks.

sentences.zh: 吳人謂開一江有一江之利，浚一浦有一浦之利。

translations.literal: Wu people say opening one river brings one river's benefit; dredging one creek brings one creek's benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Locals say each river opened pays its own dividend; each creek dredged does likewise.

sentences.zh: 願委本路監司，與諳曉水勢精強之吏，遍詣江、浦，詳究利害，假以歲月，先為之備。

translations.literal: I wish to entrust this circuit's supervisors, together with officers skilled in water conditions, to go everywhere along rivers and creeks, examine benefit and harm in detail, and with borrowed months prepare first.
translations.idiomatic: He asked supervisors and skilled hydraulic officers to survey every river and creek, plan carefully, and prepare over months before labor.

sentences.zh: 然後興夫調役，可使公無費財，而歲供常足；

translations.literal: Then mobilize labor and corvée so that the state need not waste wealth yet annual tribute is always sufficient;
translations.idiomatic: Then corvée could be raised so the treasury spent little while annual tribute stayed secure;

sentences.zh: 人不告勞，而民食不匱，是一舉而獲萬世之利也。

translations.literal: the people need not complain of toil yet food is not exhausted—one act and the benefit of ten thousand generations is gained.
translations.idiomatic: the people would not groan under labor nor lack grain—a single effort would profit generations.'

sentences.zh: 」詔吳擇仁相度以聞，開江之議復興矣。

translations.literal: ' Edict: Wu Zeren to survey and report; the proposal to open rivers revived.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zeren was ordered to survey and report; river-opening debate revived.

sentences.zh: 十一月，詔曰：「《禹貢》：'三江既導，震澤底定。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month an edict said: 'The Documents of Yu: "The three rivers were led forth, and Lake Zhen was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month edict cited Yu's Tribute: 'The three rivers were guided and Zhenze stabilized.'

sentences.zh: '今三江之名，既失其所，水不趨海，故蘇、湖被患。

translations.literal: ' Today the names of the three rivers have lost their places; water does not hasten to the sea, and therefore Su and Hu suffer affliction.
translations.idiomatic: Today's 'three rivers' no longer reach the sea, so Suzhou and Huzhou flood.'

sentences.zh: 其委本路監司，選擇能臣，檢按古跡，循導使之趨下，並相度圩岸以聞。

translations.literal: Let this circuit's supervisors choose able officers, inspect ancient traces, lead them downward, and also survey polder dykes and report.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisors were to choose capable men, trace ancient courses, direct water downward, and survey polder dykes.'

sentences.zh: 」於是復詔陳仲方為發運司屬官，再相度蘇州積水。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon Chen Zhongfang was again made an officer of the transport office to re-survey Suzhou's pooled water.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhongfang was again attached to transport to re-survey Suzhou's standing water.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，詔：「常、潤歲旱河淺，留滯運船，監司督責浚治。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year an edict said: 'Chang and Run in drought years have shallow rivers and detained transport boats; supervisors shall supervise dredging.
translations.idiomatic: Second year eighth month: drought shallowed Chang and Run rivers and delayed grain boats—supervisors must dredge.'

sentences.zh: 」三年，兩浙監司言：「承詔案古跡，導積水，今請開淘吳松江，復置十二閘。

translations.literal: ' In the third year the Two-Zhe supervisors said: 'Receiving the edict to inspect ancient traces and lead pooled water, we now request dredging Wusong and restoring twelve gates.
translations.idiomatic: Third year Two-Zhe supervisors sought Wusong dredging and twelve restored gates per the edict to follow ancient traces.'

sentences.zh: 其餘浦閘、溝港、運河之類，以次增修。

translations.literal: Other creek gates, ditch harbors, and transport canals shall be increased and repaired in order.
translations.idiomatic: Other creeks, ditches, and canals would be repaired in sequence.'

sentences.zh: 若田被水圍，勸民自行修治。

translations.literal: Where fields are encircled by water, encourage the people to repair themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Flooded fields would be left to owners for self-repair.'

sentences.zh: 」章下工部，工部謂：「今所具三江，或非禹跡；

translations.literal: ' The memorial went down to the Ministry of Works; Works said: 'The three rivers now listed may not be Yu's traces;
translations.idiomatic: Works commented: 'Listed three rivers may not be Yu's routes;

sentences.zh: 又吳松江散漫，不可開淘泄水。

translations.literal: moreover Wusong is diffuse and cannot be dredged to release water.
translations.idiomatic: Wusong is too diffuse to dredge for drainage.'

sentences.zh: 」遂命諸司再相度以聞。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon all offices were again ordered to survey and report.
translations.idiomatic: All agencies were ordered to resurvey.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，臣僚言：「有司以練湖賜茅山道觀，緣潤州田多高仰，及運渠、夾岡水淺易涸，賴湖以濟，請別用天荒江漲沙田賜之，仍令提舉常平官考求前人規畫修築。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year officials said: 'The authorities granted Lian Lake to the Maoshan Daoist abbey; Runzhou fields are mostly high-lying, and the transport canal and Jiagang water are shallow and easily dry, relying on the lake; request that other wasteland from river sand accretion be granted instead, and still order the Ever-Normal commissioner to seek former plans for repair.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year eighth month: officials protested granting Lian Lake to Maoshan abbey while Run's upland fields and shallow Jiagang canal depended on it—substitute barren tidal flats and study old repairs.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ' Approval was given.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 十月，戶部言：「乞如兩浙常平司奏，專委守、令籍古瀦水之地，立堤防之限，俾公私毋得侵佔。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Revenue Bureau said: 'As the Two-Zhe Ever-Normal office memorialized, specially entrust prefects and magistrates to register ancient water-storage lands, set dyke limits, and forbid public or private encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month Revenue urged, per Ever-Normal memorial, registering ancient reservoirs, fixing embankment bounds, and banning encroachment.'

sentences.zh: 凡民田不近水者，略仿《周官》遂人、稻人溝防之制，使合眾力而為之。

translations.literal: For civilian fields not near water, broadly imitate the Zhou Offices' ditch regulations for the marsh officer and rice officer, causing the multitude's strength to combine in making them.
translations.idiomatic: Dry upland farms should follow Zhou ditch laws so communities combine on drainage.'

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: ' Edict: approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 政和元年十月，詔蘇、湖、秀三州治水，創立圩岸，其工費許給越州鑒湖租賦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Zhenghe an edict ordered water regulation in Su, Hu, and Xiu; polder dykes were newly established, and project costs might be drawn from Shaoxing's Mirror Lake rent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe 1 tenth month: Su-Hu-Xiu waterworks and new polders could draw funds from Shaoxing's Jian Lake levy.

sentences.zh: 已而升蘇州為平江府，潤州為鎮江府。

translations.literal: Soon Suzhou was promoted to Pingjiang Prefecture and Runzhou to Zhenjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou became Pingjiang prefecture; Runzhou became Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，兵部尚書張閣言：「臣昨守杭州，聞錢塘江自元豐六年泛溢之後，潮訊往來，率無寧歲。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year Minister of War Zhang Ge said: 'When I was at Hangzhou I heard that since the Yuanfeng sixth-year flood of the Qiantang River, tidal cycles have rarely been peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe 2 seventh month: War Minister Zhang Ge recalled Hangzhou service—since Yuanfeng 6 Qiantang floods, tides had seldom been calm.

sentences.zh: 而比年水勢稍改，自海門過赭山，即回薄岩門、白石一帶北岸，壞民田及鹽亭、監地，東西三十餘里，南北二十餘里。

translations.literal: Yet in recent years the water trend has shifted somewhat; from Haimen past Zhe Mountain it now rolls back against the north bank at Yanmen and Baishi for more than thirty li east-west and twenty li north-south, ruining fields and salt pans and supervisor lands.
translations.idiomatic: Lately currents turned: tides from Haimen past Zhe Mountain scour the north shore at Yanmen and Baishi, wrecking thirty li by twenty of farms and salt works.

sentences.zh: 江東距仁和監止及三里，北趣赤岸口二十里。

translations.literal: East of the river it is only three li from Renhe Salt Supervisorate; northward toward Chian mouth is twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: East of the river only three li separate Renhe salt works; twenty li north lies Chian mouth.

sentences.zh: 運河正出臨平下塘，西入蘇、秀，若失障禦，恐他日數十里膏腴平陸，皆潰于江，下塘田廬，莫能自保，運河中絕，有害漕運。

translations.literal: The transport canal exits Xiatang of Linping west into Su and Xiu; if defenses fail, someday dozens of li of fertile plain may burst into the river, lower Xiatang fields and houses cannot protect themselves, the transport canal may be cut, harming grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: The canal leaves Linping Xiatang for Su-Xiu; lost levees could swallow tens of li of rich plain, drown Xiatang, and sever grain transport.'

sentences.zh: 」詔亟修築之。

translations.literal: ' Edict: urgently repair.
translations.idiomatic: Urgent repairs were ordered.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，工部言：「前太平州判官盧宗原請開修自江州至真州古來河道湮塞者凡七處，以成運河，入浙西一百五十里，可避一千六百里大江風濤之患；

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year the Ministry of Works said: 'Former Taiping prefecture judge Lu Zongyuan requested opening seven buried ancient channels from Jiangzhou to Zhenzhou to form a transport canal into western Zhe one hundred fifty li, avoiding one thousand six hundred li of great-river wind and waves;
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year second month: Works relayed Lu Zongyuan's plan to reopen seven silted ancient channels from Jiangzhou to Zhenzhou—a 150-li canal into western Zhe bypassing 1,600 li of Yangtze storms;

sentences.zh: 又可就土興築自古江水浸沒膏腴田，自三百頃至萬頃者凡九所，計四萬二千餘頃，其三百頃以下者又過之。

translations.literal: and from excavated earth to build fields long flooded by river water, from three hundred qing to ten thousand qing in nine places, totaling more than forty-two thousand qing, with those below three hundred qing even more.
translations.idiomatic: excavation could reclaim nine tracts of river-drowned fertile land from 300 to 10,000 qing, over 42,000 qing total, plus smaller plots.'

sentences.zh: 乞依宗原任太平州判官日已興政和圩田例，召人戶自備財力興修。

translations.literal: I beg that following the precedent when Zongyuan was judge of Taiping and polder fields were promoted in the Zhenghe era, households be summoned to supply their own wealth for construction.
translations.idiomatic: He asked households to fund works as under Zhenghe polder precedent when Zongyuan was Taiping judge.'

sentences.zh: 」詔沈鏻等相度措置。

translations.literal: ' Edict: Shen Lin and others to survey and arrange.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Lin and others were ordered to plan.

sentences.zh: 六年閏正月，知杭州李偃言：「湯村、岩門、白石等處並錢塘江通大海，日受兩潮，漸至侵齧。

translations.literal: In the intercalary first month of the sixth year Li Yan, prefect of Hangzhou, said: 'Tangcun, Yanmen, Baishi, and other places border the Qiantang where it meets the sea and daily receive both tides, gradually encroaching.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year intercalary first month: Hangzhou prefect Li Yan reported Tangcun, Yanmen, and Baishi shores eroded by twice-daily tides.

sentences.zh: 乞依六和寺岸，用石砌疊。

translations.literal: I beg to follow the Liuhe Temple bank and use stone stacking.
translations.idiomatic: He sought stone revetment like Liuhe Temple's.

sentences.zh: 」乃命劉既濟修治。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon Liu Jiji was ordered to repair.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jiji was assigned repairs.

sentences.zh: 八月，詔：「鎮江府傍臨大江，無港澳以容舟檝，三年間覆溺五百餘艘。

translations.literal: In the eighth month an edict said: 'Zhenjiang Prefecture lies beside the great river without basins to hold boats; in three years more than five hundred vessels were lost;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Zhenjiang, on the Yangtze without harbors, had lost 500 vessels in three years;

sentences.zh: 聞西有舊河，可避風濤，歲久湮廢，宜令發運司浚治。」

translations.literal: I hear westward is an old river that can avoid wind and waves; long buried, it should be dredged by the transport office.'
translations.idiomatic: an old westward channel could shelter craft and should be cleared by transport.'

sentences.zh: 是年，詔曰：「聞平江三十六浦內，自昔置閘，隨潮啟閉，歲久堙塞，致積水為患。

translations.literal: That year an edict said: 'I hear that within Pingjiang's thirty-six creeks gates were anciently set to open and close with the tide; long silted, they cause pooled water to afflict.
translations.idiomatic: That year an edict noted Pingjiang's thirty-six creeks once had tidal gates now silted, causing floods.

sentences.zh: 其令守臣莊徽專委戶曹趙霖講究利害，導歸江海，依舊置閘。

translations.literal: Let the prefect Zhuang Hui specially entrust Registrar Zhao Lin to study benefit and harm, lead back to rivers and sea, and restore gates as of old.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Zhuang Hui was to assign registrar Zhao Lin to restore gates and direct water to the sea.

sentences.zh: 」於是，發運副使應安道言：「凡港浦非要切者，皆可徐議。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon Vice Transport Commissioner Ying Andao said: 'Harbor creeks not urgent may be discussed slowly;
translations.idiomatic: Vice commissioner Ying Andao said non-urgent harbors could wait;

sentences.zh: 惟當先開昆山縣界茜涇塘等六所；

translations.literal: only first open the six sites such as Qianjing Pond on Kunshan county's border;
translations.idiomatic: six Kunshan sites including Qianjing Pond should open first;

sentences.zh: 秀之華亭縣，欲並循古法，盡去諸堰，各置小斗門；

translations.literal: in Xiuzhou's Huating county, wish broadly to follow ancient law, entirely remove all barrages, and set small sluice-gates at each;
translations.idiomatic: Huating in Xiuzhou should remove old barrages and install small sluices;

sentences.zh: 常州、鎮江府、望亭鎮，仍舊置閘。

translations.literal: Changzhou, Zhenjiang Prefecture, and Wangting town shall still set gates as before.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhou, Zhenjiang, and Wangting would keep their gates.'

sentences.zh: 」八月，詔戶曹趙霖相度役興，而兩浙擾甚。

translations.literal: ' In the eighth month an edict ordered Registrar Zhao Lin to survey labor mobilization, and the two Zhe were greatly disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month Zhao Lin was to plan corvée; Two-Zhe unrest followed.

sentences.zh: 七年四月己未，尚書省言：「盧宗原浚江，慮成搔擾。

translations.literal: In the seventh year on the day jiwei of the fourth month the Secretariat said: 'Lu Zongyuan's river dredging is feared to cause disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year fourth month jiwei: Secretariat feared Lu Zongyuan's dredging would harass the people.

sentences.zh: 」詔權罷其役，趙霖別與差遣。

translations.literal: ' Edict: temporarily halt his labor; Zhao Lin to receive separate assignment.
translations.idiomatic: His works were suspended; Zhao Lin was reassigned.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年二月，臣僚言：「江、淮、荊、漢間，荒瘠彌望，率古人一畝十鐘之地，其堤閼、水門、溝澮之跡猶存。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Xuanhe officials said: 'Between the Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Han, barren land stretches as far as the eye, yet traces of embankments, water gates, ditches, and canals of land that in antiquity yielded ten zhong per mu still survive.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 1 second month: officials noted Jiang-Huai-Jing-Han wastes where ancient ten-zhong fields still show dykes and sluices.

sentences.zh: 近絳州民呂平等詣御史台訴，乞開浚熙甯舊渠，以廣浸灌，願加稅一等。

translations.literal: Recently commoners of Jiang prefecture such as Lü Ping petitioned the Censorate to open and dredge Xining-era old canals to broaden irrigation, willing to add one grade of tax.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang commoners like Lü Ping had petitioned to reopen Xining canals for irrigation at higher tax.

sentences.zh: 則是近世陂池之利且廢矣，何暇復古哉。

translations.literal: Then the benefit of ponds and reservoirs in recent times is about to be abandoned—how can there be leisure to restore antiquity?
translations.idiomatic: Yet modern pond benefits were fading—little room to revive antiquity.

sentences.zh: 願詔常平官，有興修水利功效明白者，亟以名聞，特與褒除，以勵能者。

translations.literal: I wish an edict to Ever-Normal officers: whoever clearly achieves waterworks benefit, quickly report the name for special promotion and removal, to encourage the able.
translations.idiomatic: They urged rewarding Ever-Normal officers with clear hydraulic achievements.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ' Approval was given.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 八月，提舉專切措置水利農田所奏：「浙西諸縣各有陂湖、溝港、涇浜、湖濼，自來蓄水灌溉，及通舟楫，望令打量官按其地名、丈尺、四至，並鐫之石。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the special office for arranging waterworks and farmland memorialized: 'Each county in western Zhe has ponds, harbor creeks, Jing channels, and lakes that store water for irrigation and also pass boats; request surveying officials to record place names, dimensions, and boundaries and carve them in stone.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month the special farmland-water office sought stone inscriptions of every western Zhe pond, creek, Jing, and lake used for irrigation and shipping.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ' Approval was given.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 三月，趙霖坐增修水利不當，降兩官。

translations.literal: In the third month Zhao Lin was demoted two ranks for improper hydraulic repair.
translations.idiomatic: Third month Zhao Lin lost two ranks for faulty waterworks.

sentences.zh: 六月，詔曰：「趙霖興修水利，能募被水艱食之民，凡役工二百七十八萬二千四百有奇，開一江、一港、四浦、五十八瀆，已見成績，進直徽猷閣，仍復所降兩官。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month an edict said: 'Zhao Lin in waterworks was able to recruit people afflicted by flood and hunger; total labor was two million seven hundred eighty-two thousand four hundred odd; he opened one river, one harbor, four creeks, and fifty-eight drains, with achievements already seen; he was promoted to direct Expectant of Huixian Pavilion and still restored the two ranks demoted.'
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month edict praised Zhao Lin for recruiting flood victims—2.78 million labor units, one river, one harbor, four creeks, fifty-eight drains—and restored his ranks while promoting him to Huixian Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年九月，以真、揚等州運河淺澀，委陳亨伯措置。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Xuanhe, because the transport canals of Zhen and Yang were shallow, Chen Hengbo was entrusted to arrange.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 2 ninth month: shallow Zhen-Yang canals brought Chen Hengbo to arrange repairs.

sentences.zh: 三年春，詔發運副使趙億以車畎水運河，限三月中三十綱到京。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year an edict ordered Vice Transport Commissioner Zhao Yi to lift canal water by cart within the third month for thirty convoys to reach the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Third year spring: Zhao Yi must cart water into canals so thirty grain convoys reach the capital by month's end.

sentences.zh: 宦者李琮言：「真州乃外江綱運會集要口，以運河淺澀，故不能速發。

translations.literal: Eunuch Li Cong said: 'Zhenzhou is the vital junction where outer-river convoys assemble; because the transport canal is shallow, rapid dispatch is impossible.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Li Cong noted Zhenzhou's outer-river assembly point was slowed by shallow canals.

sentences.zh: 按南岸有泄水斗門八，去江不滿一里。

translations.literal: Along the south bank are eight drainage sluice-gates less than one li from the river.
translations.idiomatic: Eight drainage gates stand within one li of the south bank.

sentences.zh: 欲開斗門河身，去江十丈築軟壩，引江潮入河，然後倍用人工車畎，以助運水。

translations.literal: I wish to open the sluice-gate river bed, ten zhang from the river build a soft dam, draw river tide into the canal, and then double manual cart-lifting to aid transport water.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed opening gate channels, building a soft dam ten zhang from the river, admitting tide, and doubling cart lifting.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ' Approval was given.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔曰：「江、淮漕運尚矣。

translations.literal: In the fourth month an edict said: 'Jiang-Huai grain transport is of long standing.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month edict reviewed Jiang-Huai transport history.

sentences.zh: 春秋時，吳穿邗溝，東北通射陽湖，西北至末口。

translations.literal: In Spring and Autumn Wu cut the Han Gou, northeast reaching Sheyang Lake, northwest to Mokou.
translations.idiomatic: Spring and Autumn Wu cut the Han Gou northeast to Sheyang Lake and northwest to Mokou.

sentences.zh: 漢吳王濞開邗溝，通運海陵。

translations.literal: Han King Liu Bi opened the Han Gou to reach Hai-ling for transport.
translations.idiomatic: Han King Liu Bi reopened it to Hai-ling for shipping.

sentences.zh: 隋開邗溝，自山陽至揚子入江。

translations.literal: Sui opened the Han Gou from Shanyang to Yangzi entering the river.
translations.idiomatic: Sui extended it from Shanyang to Yangzi mouth.

sentences.zh: 雍熙中，轉運使劉蟠以山陽灣迅急，始開沙河以避險阻。

translations.literal: In Yongxi, Transport Commissioner Liu Pan because Shanyang Bay was swift began opening the Sha River to avoid peril.
translations.idiomatic: Yongxi commissioner Liu Pan cut the Sha River to avoid Shanyang Bay.

sentences.zh: 天禧中，發運使賈宗始開揚州古河，繚城南接運渠，毀三堰以均水勢。

translations.literal: In Tianxi, Transport Commissioner Jia Zong first opened Yangzhou's ancient river winding south of the city to join the transport channel and destroyed three barrages to equalize water.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi commissioner Jia Zong opened Yangzhou's old south-channel and removed three barrages.

sentences.zh: 今運河歲淺澀，當詢訪故道，及今河形勢與陂塘瀦水之地，講究措置悠久之利，以濟不通。

translations.literal: Today the transport canal yearly silts shallow; the old course and present river configuration with pond and storage lands should be studied for lasting benefit to remedy blockage.
translations.idiomatic: Today's canal silts yearly—old courses, present channels, and storage ponds need study for lasting relief.'

sentences.zh: 可令發運使陳亨伯、內侍譚稹條具措置以聞。」

translations.literal: Let Transport Commissioner Chen Hengbo and inner attendant Tan Zhen itemize arrangements and report.'
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hengbo and eunuch Tan Zhen were to report plans.'

sentences.zh: 八月，臣僚言：「比緣淮南運河水澀逾半歲，禁綱舟篙工附載私物，今河水增漲，其令如舊。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month officials said: 'Recently because Huainan transport water was shallow more than half a year, grain-boat polemen were forbidden to carry private goods; now the river has risen and the old rule should apply.'
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: after half a year of shallow Huainan canals forbidding private cargo on grain boats, rising water restored the old rule.'

sentences.zh: 初，淮南連歲旱，漕運不通，揚州尤甚，詔中使按視，欲浚運河與江、淮平。

translations.literal: Earlier Huainan had drought several years and transport did not pass; Yangzhou was especially afflicted; an edict sent a palace envoy to inspect, wishing to dredge the transport canal level with the Jiang and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier multi-year Huainan drought had blocked transport, worst at Yangzhou; palace envoys were sent to level canals with Jiang and Huai.

sentences.zh: 會兩浙有方臘之亂，內侍童貫為宣撫使，譚稹為制置使，貫欲海運陸輦，稹欲開一河，自盱眙出宣化。

translations.literal: When the two Zhe had Fang La's rebellion, eunuch Tong Guan was pacification commissioner and Tan Zhen was disposition commissioner; Guan wished sea transport and overland haul; Zhen wished to open a river from Xuyi out Xuanhua.
translations.idiomatic: During Fang La's rebellion Tong Guan favored sea and land routes while Tan Zhen urged a canal from Xuyi to Xuanhua.

sentences.zh: 朝廷下發運司相度，陳亨伯遣其屬向子諲視之。

translations.literal: The court sent it down to the transport office to survey; Chen Hengbo sent his subordinate Xiang Ziyin to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Transport was ordered to survey; Hengbo sent Xiang Ziyin.

sentences.zh: 子諲曰：「運河高江、淮數丈，自江至淮，凡數百里，人力難浚。

translations.literal: Ziyin said: 'The transport canal is several zhang higher than the Jiang and Huai; from river to Huai is several hundred li—human strength can hardly dredge it.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyin argued the canal sits several zhang above Jiang and Huai across hundreds of li—beyond manual dredging.

sentences.zh: 昔唐李吉甫廢閘置堰，治陂塘，泄有餘，防不足，漕運通流。

translations.literal: Formerly Tang Li Jifu abolished gates and set barrages, regulated ponds and reservoirs, released surplus and blocked deficiency, and transport flowed.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Li Jifu had removed locks for barrages, regulated ponds, released surplus and held shortage, and transport flowed.

sentences.zh: 發運使曾孝蘊嚴三日一啟之制，復作歸水澳，惜水如金。

translations.literal: Transport Commissioner Zeng Xiaoyun strictly enforced opening every three days, again making return-water basins, cherishing water like gold.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Zeng Xiaoyun enforced three-day opening cycles and return basins, hoarding water like gold.

sentences.zh: 比年行直達之法，走茶鹽之利，且應奉權幸，朝夕經由，或啟或閉，不暇歸水。

translations.literal: In recent years the direct-transport method ran, pursuing tea and salt profit, and answering favorites morning and evening passing through, sometimes opening sometimes closing, with no leisure to return water.
translations.idiomatic: Lately direct transport chased tea-salt profits and court favorites, opening and closing at whim without restoring basins.

sentences.zh: 又頃毀朝宗閘，自洪澤至召伯數百里，不為之節，故山陽上下不通。

translations.literal: Moreover the Chaozong gate was recently destroyed; from Hongze to Zhaobo for several hundred li nothing regulated it, and therefore above and below Shanyang did not connect.
translations.idiomatic: Destroying Chaozong gate left hundreds of li from Hongze to Zhaobo unregulated, severing Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 欲救其弊，宜於真州太子港作一壩，以復懷子河故道，於瓜州河口作一壩，以復龍舟堰，於海陵河口作一壩，以復茱萸、待賢堰，使諸塘水不為瓜洲、真、泰三河所分，於北神相近作一壩，權閉滿浦閘，復朝宗閘，則上下無壅矣。

translations.literal: To remedy the affliction, at Zhenzhou Taizi Harbor make one dam to restore the Huaizi River old course; at Guazhou river mouth make one dam to restore the Longzhou barrage; at Hailing river mouth make one dam to restore the Zhuyu and Daixian barrages, so that the various pond waters are not divided by the three rivers of Guazhou, Zhen, and Tai; near Beishen make one dam, temporarily close Manpu gate, restore Chaozong gate—then above and below will not be blocked.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed dams at Taizi Harbor, Guazhou, and Hailing to restore old barrages, reunite pond waters divided by Guazhou-Zhen-Tai branches, temporarily close Manpu, and reopen Chaozong to free Shanyang traffic.'

sentences.zh: 」亨伯用其言，是後滯舟皆通利雲。

translations.literal: ' Hengbo used his words; thereafter detained boats all passed smoothly.
translations.idiomatic: Hengbo adopted the plan and stalled convoys moved freely.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，詔：「趙之鑒湖，明之廣德湖，自措置為田，下流堙塞，有妨灌溉，致失常賦，又多為權勢所占，兩州被害，民以流徙。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year an edict said: 'The Jian Lake of Yue and Guangde Lake of Ming, since being converted to fields, downstream was silted, harming irrigation, causing irregular tax, and much occupied by the powerful; both prefectures suffered and people fled.
translations.idiomatic: Third year second month: edict noted Shaoxing's Jian and Ming's Guangde lakes, once diked into fields, had silted downstream, ruined irrigation, skewed taxes, and enriched the powerful while people fled.'

sentences.zh: 宜令陳亨伯究實，如租稅過重，即裁為中制；

translations.literal: Let Chen Hengbo investigate in fact; if rent and tax are too heavy, cut to middle measure;
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hengbo was to investigate and moderate excessive rents;

sentences.zh: 應妨下流灌溉者，並馳以予民。」

translations.literal: whatever harms downstream irrigation, promptly grant to the people.'
translations.idiomatic: lands blocking downstream irrigation were to be returned to commoners.'

sentences.zh: 五年三月，詔：「呂城至鎮江運河淺澀狹隘，監司坐視，無所施設，兩浙專委王復，淮南專委向子諲，同發運使呂淙措置車水，通濟舟運。」

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year an edict said: 'From Lücheng to Zhenjiang the transport canal is shallow, narrow, and silted; supervisors sat watching without acting; western Zhe specially entrusts Wang Fu, Huainan entrusts Xiang Ziyin, together with Transport Commissioner Lü Cong to arrange cart-lifting water to pass boat transport.'
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month third year: shallow Lücheng-Zhenjiang canal brought Wang Fu for Two-Zhe, Xiang Ziyin for Huainan, and Lü Cong for cart-lifting under transport.

sentences.zh: 四月，又命王仲閎同廉訪劉仲元、漕臣孟庾專往來措置常、潤運河。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Wang Zhonghong was also ordered together with surveillance commissioner Liu Zhongyuan and grain commissioner Meng Yu to go back and forth arranging the Chang and Run transport canal.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month Wang Zhonghong joined surveillance commissioner Liu Zhongyuan and grain commissioner Meng Yu on Chang-Run canals.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「東南六路諸閘，啟閉有時。

translations.literal: Again an edict said: 'Southeast six circuits' various gates have seasons for opening and closing.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict noted timed operation of southeast locks.

sentences.zh: 比聞綱舟及命官妄稱專承指揮，抑令非時啟版，走泄河水，妨滯綱運，誤中都歲計，其禁止之。」

translations.literal: I hear grain boats and commissioned officers falsely claim special orders, suppressing untimely opening of boards, releasing river water, obstructing transport, and harming the capital's annual plan—this is forbidden.'
translations.idiomatic: Grain crews and officers forcing untimely openings that drained canals and harmed capital supply were forbidden.'

sentences.zh: 五月，詔：「以運河淺涸，官吏互執所見，州縣莫知所從。

translations.literal: In the fifth month an edict said: 'Because the transport canal is shallow and dry, officials mutually hold their views and prefectures and counties do not know whom to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: shallow canals left officials divided and counties uncertain whom to obey.

sentences.zh: 其令發運司提舉等官同廉訪使者，參訂經久利便列奏。

translations.literal: Let the transport office's supervisory officers and other officers together with surveillance envoys jointly fix lasting benefit and memorialize in series.
translations.idiomatic: Transport supervisory officers and surveillance envoys were to draft lasting remedies.

sentences.zh: 」是月，臣僚言：「鎮江府練湖，與新豐塘地理相接，八百餘頃，灌溉四縣民田。

translations.literal: ' That month officials said: 'Lian Lake of Zhenjiang Prefecture connects geographically with Xinfeng Pond, eight hundred odd qing, irrigating civilian fields of four counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month officials reported Zhenjiang's 800-odd qing Lian Lake linked to Xinfeng Pond and irrigated four counties.

sentences.zh: 又湖水一寸，益漕河一尺，其來久矣。

translations.literal: Moreover one cun of lake water adds one chi to the transport canal—a practice of long standing.
translations.idiomatic: Each cun of lake water had long raised the canal one chi.

sentences.zh: 今堤岸損缺，不能貯水，乞候農隙次第補葺。

translations.literal: Now the dyke banks are damaged and cannot store water; I beg to repair in order when the agricultural interval comes.
translations.idiomatic: Breached banks no longer held water—repairs were sought at the farming slack season.'

sentences.zh: 」詔本路漕臣並本州縣官詳度利害，檢計工料以聞。

translations.literal: ' Edict: this circuit's grain commissioner together with this prefecture and county officers to survey benefit and harm in detail, inspect and tally materials and report.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit grain officers and local magistrates were to survey costs and report.

sentences.zh: 六年九月，盧宗原復言：「池州大江，乃上流綱運所經，其東岸皆暗石，多至二十餘處；

translations.literal: In the sixth year of the ninth month Lu Zongyuan again said: 'The great river of Chizhou is what upstream convoys pass; on the east bank are hidden rocks in more than twenty places;
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year ninth month Lu Zongyuan noted Chizhou's Yangtze, the upstream grain route, had twenty-odd hidden rocks on the east bank;

sentences.zh: 西岸則沙洲，廣二百餘里。

translations.literal: the west bank is sandbars two hundred odd li wide.
translations.idiomatic: the west held sandbars two hundred li wide.

sentences.zh: 諺雲'拆船灣'，言舟至此，必毀拆也。

translations.literal: A proverb says "Boat-Dismantling Bay," meaning boats reaching here must be wrecked and dismantled.
translations.idiomatic: Locals called it 'Dismantle-the-Boat Bay'—craft here were torn apart.

sentences.zh: 今東岸有車軸河口沙地四百餘里，若開通入杜湖，使舟經平水，徑池口，可避二百里風濤拆船之險，請措置開修。

translations.literal: Now on the east bank is Chezhou River mouth sand land four hundred odd li; if opened through into Du Lake so boats pass calm water straight to Chikou, one may avoid two hundred li of wind, waves, and boat-wrecking peril; request arrangement to open and repair.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed cutting 400 li of east-bank sand into Du Lake for a calm route to Chikou, avoiding 200 li of storms—requesting approval to open it.'

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ' Approval was given.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 七年九月丙子，又詔宗原措置開浚江東古河，白蕪湖由宣溪、溧水至鎮江，渡揚子，趨淮、汴，免六百里江行之險，並從之。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi of the ninth month of the seventh year again an edict ordered Zongyuan to arrange opening and dredging the ancient river east of the river from Wuhu through Xuankou and Lishui to Zhenjiang, crossing the Yangtze to hurry to Huai and Bian, avoiding six hundred li of river travel's peril—and all was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year ninth month bingzi: Zongyuan was again ordered to open the east-bank ancient route Wuhu–Xuankou–Lishui–Zhenjiang, cross the Yangtze toward Huai and Bian, saving 600 li of river peril—all approved.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年三月丁卯，臣僚言：「東南瀕江海，水易泄而多旱，歷代皆有陂湖蓄水。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao of the third month of the first year of Jingkang officials said: 'The southeast borders the sea; water easily drains yet drought is frequent; every dynasty had ponds and lakes to store water.
translations.idiomatic: Jingkang 1 third month dingmao: officials said the coastal southeast drains easily yet droughts abound; dynasties kept storage lakes.

sentences.zh: 祥符、慶曆間，民始盜陂湖為田，後復田為湖。

translations.literal: Between Xiangfu and Qingli the people first stole ponds and lakes for fields; later fields were again made lakes.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangfu–Qingli eras saw ponds reclaimed then restored.

sentences.zh: 近年以來，復廢為田，雨則澇，旱則涸。

translations.literal: In recent years they were again abandoned for fields; in rain there is flood, in drought there is dry exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: Lately lakes were again diked—rain brought floods, drought brought dearth.

sentences.zh: 民久承佃，所收租稅，無計可脫，悉歸御前，而漕司之常賦有虧，民之失業無算。

translations.literal: The people long held lease contracts; collected rent and tax could not be escaped, all going to the imperial privy while the transport office's regular levy was deficient and the people's lost livelihood beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Tenants could not escape rents flowing to the privy purse while transport taxes fell short and livelihoods collapsed.

sentences.zh: 可乞盡括東南廢湖為田者，復以為湖，度幾凋瘵之民，稍復故業。

translations.literal: I beg to exhaustively catalog southeast abandoned lakes made into fields, restore them as lakes, estimating how many afflicted people might slightly recover former livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: They begged cataloging every diked lake in the southeast for restoration to ease distressed populations.'

sentences.zh: 」詔相度利害聞奏。

translations.literal: ' Edict: survey benefit and harm and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: survey and report.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，戶部言：「命官在任興修農田水利，依元豐賞格，千頃以上，該第一等，轉一官，下至百頃，皆等第酬獎；

translations.literal: On the day xinchou of the eighth month the Revenue Bureau said: 'Commissioned officers who in office open farmland waterworks, according to the Yuanfeng reward scale, one thousand qing and above qualify for the first grade, one rank promotion; down to one hundred qing all receive graded rewards;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month xinchou: Revenue cited Yuanfeng rewards—1,000 qing or more merited one rank, down to 100 qing in graded prizes for hydraulic work by officials in office;

sentences.zh: 紹聖亦如之。

translations.literal: Shaosheng was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Shaosheng followed the same scale.

sentences.zh: 緣政和續附常平格，千頃增立轉兩官，減磨勘三年，實為太優。

translations.literal: Because the Zhenghe supplement to the Ever-Normal scale added two ranks for one thousand qing and reduced merit review three years—it is truly too generous.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe's Ever-Normal supplement granting two ranks and three years off merit review for 1,000 qing was excessively generous.

sentences.zh: 」詔依元豐、紹聖舊格。

translations.literal: ' Edict: follow the old scales of Yuanfeng and Shaosheng.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: revert to Yuanfeng and Shaosheng standards.
